phrase: a Saree Petticoat and Shapewear Brand
verdict: Yes. Sayonara from Kolkata pitched petticoats on Shark Tank India Season 2, but didn't get a deal. Saree petticoats are a daily need, and better fits and fabrics can build a loyal market.
angle: Saree shapewear and petticoats sell to millions of saree wearers. Comfort and fit drive loyalty. Kolkata is a major innerwear cluster.
